entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: He was later given a ten-place grid penalty for the Japanese Grand Prix. Vettel controlled the race from the second restart, beating Jenson Button to the line, for his second win of the season and his first since the Bahrain Grand Prix five months previously.

entities.name: Jenson Button
entities.description: He was beaten by Sebastian Vettel to the line.

entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: He completed the podium, retaining his championship lead after defending from Paul di Resta late in the race.

entities.name: Paul di Resta
entities.description: He was defended against by Fernando Alonso late in the race.
